U11 course-grounding tests only. Pages are separated by form feed.
MA 105 Lecture 13 — Surfaces and flux (sample).
The flux of a vector field F through an oriented surface S is the
surface integral of F dot n over S.
For a closed surface the flux equals the triple integral of div F.

MA 105 Lecture 13 — Surfaces and flux (sample), page 2.
Green's theorem relates a line integral around a closed curve to a
double integral over the region it encloses.
The region must be positively oriented: the boundary is traversed
counterclockwise.

MA 105 Lecture 13 — Surfaces and flux (sample), page 3.
Stokes' theorem relates the line integral around a closed curve to
the surface integral of the curl over any surface it bounds.
A vector field with zero curl on a simply connected region is
conservative.
